visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short dark hair, wearing a black shirt, is seen in a well-lit indoor room featuring a large bookshelf and a guitar in the background. He holds a bright blue bottle and uses a small folding knife to meticulously scrape and slice through the plastic seal around the neck. His facial expression is concentrated and serious as he works on the bottle on a desk. (2) After removing the seal, he grips the top of the bottle and twists the cork stopper with a firm hand motion until it pulls free from the neck. He immediately brings the bottom of the cork to his nose, closing his eyes slightly to deeply inhale the aroma of the liquid while holding the bottle steady in his other hand. (3) He carefully tilts the blue bottle over a clear glass, pouring a moderate amount of golden-brown liquid. The camera angle is an eye-level medium close-up that focuses on his upper body and the objects on the desk in front of him. There is no camera movement or editing cuts during this pouring sequence. (4) He raises the glass to his mouth and takes a significant sip of the beverage. His face instantly contorts into a sharp grimace with tightly shut eyes and a wrinkled brow, physically reacting to the high alcohol content. After a few seconds, he relaxes his face, smiles broadly, and looks directly at the camera with an expression of enjoyment and satisfaction.

There is no background music present, and the acoustic floor is extremely clean, indicating a studio-like environment with no outside noise interference. (2) A distinct, resonant "pop" sound is heard as the cork is pulled from the bottle, followed by the faint sound of the cork being handled. The person breathes audibly and deeply, indicating a deep sniff of the bottle's contents, while the overall noise floor remains extremely low. (3) A clear, rhythmic glugging sound occurs as liquid is poured into a glass, with the pitch of the bubbles changing slightly as the glass fills up. The sound has high spectral brightness and clarity, with no interference from other sound sources or electronic music. (4) After a period of silence, the sound of a swallow is followed by a sharp, high-arousal vocal exhale and a series of vocal "Ah" and "Ooh" sounds. These vocalizations exhibit high pitch variability and a strained quality, reflecting a strong physical reaction to the intense flavor.
